improvements.name: Service-first landing routing
improvements.problem: Users clicking "Book" go to generic /book. No service pre-selection.
improvements.fix: Route ?service=fitting to /book?service=club-fitting pre-filled. Create: /book?service=coaching and /book?service=practice variants.

improvements.name: Abandoned booking WhatsApp nudge
improvements.problem: Form started but not submitted — zero recovery.
improvements.fix: If user reaches /book and leaves without submitting: capture session, retarget via WhatsApp within 2h with "Still interested? Your session is waiting — R250 to confirm."

improvements.name: "Coming for fitting?" direct flow
improvements.problem: Fitting visitors get same booking flow as coaching. Fitting = higher intent, faster decision.
improvements.fix: On /club-fitting page, primary CTA goes directly to fitting-specific booking: "Book Fitting Assessment — R900". No "general inquiry" step.

improvements.name: Mobile booking-first redesign
improvements.problem: Mobile traffic high, desktop conversion higher — mobile booking is friction-heavy.
improvements.fix: Mobile: single-page booking with large touch targets, WhatsApp option prominent, progress bar, minimal fields.

improvements.name: Pre-filled booking with WhatsApp
improvements.fix: Auto-populate name/email from first visit cookie. Show "Welcome back, [name] — book in 30 seconds."

improvements.name: Booking reminder sequence
improvements.fix: At booking confirmation: "See you [date] — we'll send a WhatsApp reminder 24h before." Then auto-send reminder via WhatsApp.

improvements.name: Post-lesson membership upsell
improvements.problem: Coaching clients don't naturally move to membership.
improvements.fix: After first coaching lesson confirmation: "Want unlimited practice between lessons? R1,800/month — add it now." One-click upsell inline.
